name: @mcp-abap-adt/core-ro

tools.name: GetTableContents
tools.description: [read-only] Reads the contents (data preview, like SE16/SE16N) of the ABAP database table or CDS view named by table_name: every column, up to max_rows rows (default 100). Answers sql_query, row_number (the max_rows asked), execution_time, total_rows (the rows the table or view holds), columns and rows. Runs on an ABAP session of its own. Optional timeout (seconds): when it passes, the read is cancelled, its ABAP session logged off, and the system stays as it was. Set it below your MCP client's request limit — the TypeScript SDK's client cancels at 60 s; a client's cancel ends only the client's wait, and SAP runs the read on. Recordable: in batch mode a call is recorded under the next number and answers with empty content; its answer is read by number after the batch ends.

timeout.description: Seconds to wait for the answer: a whole number, at least 1, no default — without it the call waits until SAP answers. When it passes, the read is cancelled (its ABAP session is logged off) and the call answers that nothing was changed. Set it below your MCP client's request limit — the TypeScript SDK's client cancels at 60 s; a cancel does nothing to SAP.

max_rows.description: Maximum number of rows to retrieve

detail.description: How much of the answer to return: "terse" (default, the fields you need to act), "full" (the whole parse), "raw" (the document as ADT sent it).

tools.name: GetPackageContents
tools.description: [read-only] Retrieve objects inside an ABAP package as a flat list. Supports recursive traversal of subpackages. Takes package_name (one package: its list) or package_names (several packages: one entry per package, in the order given, each { package_name, objects } or { package_name, error }). Each level of the walk is read in one ADT batch envelope: the root node structures of its packages, then their type nodes; with include_descriptions, as single requests, several at a time. Runs on an ABAP session of its own. Optional timeout (seconds): when it passes, the read is cancelled, its ABAP session logged off, and the system stays as it was. Set it below your MCP client's request limit — the TypeScript SDK's client cancels at 60 s; a client's cancel ends only the client's wait, and SAP runs the read on. Runs outside batch mode.

timeout.description: Seconds to wait for the answer: a whole number, at least 1, no default — without it the call waits until SAP answers. When it passes, the read is cancelled (its ABAP session is logged off) and the call answers that nothing was changed. Set it below your MCP client's request limit — the TypeScript SDK's client cancels at 60 s; a cancel does nothing to SAP.

package_name.description: Name of the ABAP package (give this or package_names)

package_names.description: Names of several ABAP packages, read together (give this or package_name)

include_subpackages.description: Include contents of subpackages recursively (default: false)

max_depth.description: Maximum depth for recursive package traversal (default: 5)

include_descriptions.description: Include each object's description in the response. The walk's levels are then read as single requests, several at a time, rather than in ADT batch envelopes (default: false)

tools.name: GetInclude
tools.description: [read-only] Read ANY single ABAP include source by name, from anywhere in the repository (an include may live outside any single program tree). Reads includes (PROG/I) by name. Recordable: in batch mode a call is recorded under the next number and answers with empty content; its answer is read by number after the batch ends.

tools.name: GetIncludesList
tools.description: [read-only] Recursively discover and list ALL include files within an ABAP program or include. Takes object_name and object_type (one object: its tree) or objects (several objects: one entry per object, in the order given, each { object_name, object_type, tree } or { object_name, object_type, error }). Runs on an ABAP session of its own. Optional timeout (seconds): when it passes, the read is cancelled, its ABAP session logged off, and the system stays as it was. Set it below your MCP client's request limit — the TypeScript SDK's client cancels at 60 s; a client's cancel ends only the client's wait, and SAP runs the read on. Runs outside batch mode.

timeout.description: Seconds to wait for the answer: a whole number, at least 1, no default — without it the call waits until SAP answers. When it passes, the read is cancelled (its ABAP session is logged off) and the call answers that nothing was changed. Set it below your MCP client's request limit — the TypeScript SDK's client cancels at 60 s; a cancel does nothing to SAP.

object_name.description: Name of the ABAP program or include (with object_type; or give objects)

object_type.description: [read-only] ADT object type of the parent. Only these four values are supported: 'PROG/P' (program), 'PROG/I' (include), 'FUGR' (function group), 'CLAS/OC' (class). Any other value is rejected by the schema.

objects.description: [read-only] Several objects, read together (give this or object_name and object_type)

object_name.description: Name of the ABAP program or include

detailed.description: [read-only] If true, returns structured JSON with metadata and raw XML.

tools.name: GetEnhancements
tools.description: [read-only] Lists the enhancements (enhancement implementations) of the program, include, function group or class named by object_name and object_type. Takes object_name and object_type (one object: its enhancements) or objects (several objects: one entry per object, in the order given, each its enhancements answer or { object_name, object_type, error }). When object_type is one of CLASS, CLAS, CLAS/OC, FUNCTION_GROUP, FUNCTIONGROUP, FUGR, FUGR/F, PROGRAM, PROG, PROG/P and include_nested is any value but true, recordable: in batch mode a call is recorded under the next number and answers with empty content; its answer is read by number after the batch ends.

object_name.description: Name of the ABAP object (with object_type; or give objects)

objects.description: [read-only] Several objects, read together (give this or object_name and object_type)

tools.name: GetEnhancementSpot
tools.description: [read-only] Retrieve metadata and list of implementations for a specific enhancement spot. Runs outside batch mode.

tools.name: GetEnhancementImpl
tools.description: [read-only] Retrieve source code of a specific enhancement implementation by its name and enhancement spot. Runs outside batch mode.

tools.name: GetTransport
tools.description: [read-only] Retrieve ABAP transport request information including metadata, included objects, and status from SAP system. Recordable: in batch mode a call is recorded under the next number and answers with empty content; its answer is read by number after the batch ends.

transport_number.description: Transport request number, not a task

include_objects.description: Include list of objects in transport (default: true)

include_tasks.description: Include list of tasks in transport (default: true)

tools.name: ListTransports
tools.description: [read-only] List transport requests for the current or specified user. Returns modifiable and/or released workbench and customizing requests. `user` and modifiable-only are both applied client-side, over every request the server's default search configuration answers; ADT receives the default search alone. Runs on an ABAP session of its own. Optional timeout (seconds): when it passes, the read is cancelled, its ABAP session logged off, and the system stays as it was. Set it below your MCP client's request limit — the TypeScript SDK's client cancels at 60 s; a client's cancel ends only the client's wait, and SAP runs the read on. Runs outside batch mode.

timeout.description: Seconds to wait for the answer: a whole number, at least 1, no default — without it the call waits until SAP answers. When it passes, the read is cancelled (its ABAP session is logged off) and the call answers that nothing was changed. Set it below your MCP client's request limit — the TypeScript SDK's client cancels at 60 s; a cancel does nothing to SAP.

user.description: The user to filter to: an SAP user id (matched in upper case); applied client-side. If not provided, defaults to the current session user, so an unfiltered call already answers only that user's transports.

modifiable_only.description: Only return modifiable (not yet released) transports; applied client-side. Default: true.

detail.description: How much of the answer to return: "terse" (default, the fields you need to act), "full" (the whole parse), "raw" (the document as ADT sent it).

tools.name: ReadTransportObjects
tools.description: [read-only] Lists the objects the transport request or task named by transport_number holds, each with its `position`, which a removal of the entry names. A task answers its own entries; a request answers every task's entries, each once, with its `task` number and position — the task a removal addresses. Recordable: in batch mode a call is recorded under the next number and answers with empty content; its answer is read by number after the batch ends.

transport_number.description: Transport REQUEST or TASK number. A task answers its own entries; a request answers the entries of each of its tasks, each with its `task` number — the task a removal addresses.

detail.description: How much of the answer to return: "terse" (default, the fields you need to act), "full" (the whole parse), "raw" (the document as ADT sent it).

tools.name: ReadTransportActionLog
tools.description: [read-only] Reads the action log of the transport request named by transport_number: one entry per lifecycle event — created, object added, object deleted, owner changed. It confirms that an object entry was taken out of the request, since a removal answers by echoing what it was asked. Recordable: in batch mode a call is recorded under the next number and answers with empty content; its answer is read by number after the batch ends.

transport_number.description: Transport REQUEST or TASK number. A request answers its own lifecycle events; a task answers the events of the objects on it.

detail.description: How much of the answer to return: "terse" (default, the fields you need to act), "full" (the whole parse), "raw" (the document as ADT sent it).

tools.name: GetStructuresList
tools.description: [read-only] Recursively list the structures embedded in an ABAP structure (.INCLUDE / append), as a tree. Takes structure_name (one structure: its tree) or structure_names (several structures: one entry per structure, in the order given, each its tree answer or { structure_name, error }). Works on BASIS 7.50 and later, where the DDIC structure/table endpoints it reads exist; legacy systems (BASIS < 7.50) refuse it (issue #207). Runs on an ABAP session of its own. Optional timeout (seconds): when it passes, the read is cancelled, its ABAP session logged off, and the system stays as it was. Set it below your MCP client's request limit — the TypeScript SDK's client cancels at 60 s; a client's cancel ends only the client's wait, and SAP runs the read on. Runs outside batch mode.

timeout.description: Seconds to wait for the answer: a whole number, at least 1, no default — without it the call waits until SAP answers. When it passes, the read is cancelled (its ABAP session is logged off) and the call answers that nothing was changed. Set it below your MCP client's request limit — the TypeScript SDK's client cancels at 60 s; a cancel does nothing to SAP.

structure_names.description: Several structure names, read together (give this or structure_name).

include_extensions.description: [read-only] Also find extension (append) structures via where-used (objects that `extend type <this> with …`). Default true. Set false to skip the (slower) where-used lookups and return includes only.

tools.name: GetObjectVersions
tools.description: [read-only] Lists the version history of the class, program, interface, function module, table, structure, CDS view, behavior definition or metadata extension named by object_name and object_type. Returns each version with its versionId, author, updatedAt, title, the transportRequest (and transportDescription) that produced it when available, and the opaque content_uri that names the version's source. Recordable: in batch mode a call is recorded under the next number and answers with empty content; its answer is read by number after the batch ends.

function_group_name.description: Owning function group name. Required when object_type is function_module.

tools.name: GetObjectVersionSource
tools.description: [read-only] Reads the source code of the object version named by content_uri, an entry of an object's version history, for the object type named by object_type. Recordable: in batch mode a call is recorded under the next number and answers with empty content; its answer is read by number after the batch ends.

object_type.description: Object type (the same value the version history was read with).

content_uri.description: Opaque content_uri of a version, from the object's version history.

tools.name: GetObjectVersionDiff
tools.description: [read-only] Compares the two object versions named by content_uri_from and content_uri_to, entries of an object's version history, for the object type named by object_type: returns the unified diff (jsdiff) of their sources. Recordable: in batch mode a call is recorded under the next number and answers with empty content; its answer is read by number after the batch ends.

object_type.description: Object type (the same value the version history was read with).

content_uri_from.description: Opaque content_uri of the OLD/base version (from the object's version history).

content_uri_to.description: Opaque content_uri of the NEW/compare version (from the object's version history).

tools.name: ListFunctionGroupIncludes
tools.description: [read-only] List the includes (TOP, custom) of an ABAP function group. Runs outside batch mode.

tools.name: ListFunctionModules
tools.description: [read-only] List the function modules of an ABAP function group. Runs outside batch mode.

tools.name: GetBehaviorDefinition
tools.description: [read-only] Reads the RAP behavior definition named by behavior_definition_name in one request: its source code (part "source", the default; active or inactive version) or its ADT metadata document (part "metadata": package, responsible, description). Returns the part read. Recordable: in batch mode a call is recorded under the next number and answers with empty content; its answer is read by number after the batch ends.

part.description: The document to read: "source" (default) the source code, "metadata" the ADT metadata document (package, responsible, description, ...).

version.description: Version of the source: "active" (default) for the deployed version, "inactive" for the modified version awaiting activation.

tools.name: GetBehaviorImplementation
tools.description: [read-only] Reads the RAP behavior implementation (its class) named by behavior_implementation_name in one request: its source code (part "source", the default; active or inactive version) or its ADT metadata document (part "metadata": package, responsible, description). Returns the part read. Recordable: in batch mode a call is recorded under the next number and answers with empty content; its answer is read by number after the batch ends.

part.description: The document to read: "source" (default) the source code, "metadata" the ADT metadata document (package, responsible, description, ...).

version.description: Version of the source: "active" (default) for the deployed version, "inactive" for the modified version awaiting activation.

tools.name: GetClass
tools.description: [read-only] Reads the ABAP class named by class_name in one request: its source code (part "source", the default; active or inactive version) or its ADT metadata document (part "metadata": package, responsible, description). Returns the part read. Recordable: in batch mode a call is recorded under the next number and answers with empty content; its answer is read by number after the batch ends.

part.description: The document to read: "source" (default) the source code, "metadata" the ADT metadata document (package, responsible, description, ...).

version.description: Version of the source: "active" (default) for the deployed version, "inactive" for the modified version awaiting activation.

tools.name: GetDataElement
tools.description: [read-only] Reads the ABAP data element named by data_element_name in one request: its ADT metadata document (definition, package, description). Returns it under `metadata`, with `part: "metadata"`. Recordable: in batch mode a call is recorded under the next number and answers with empty content; its answer is read by number after the batch ends.

version.description: Version to read: "active" (default) for deployed version, "inactive" for modified but not activated version.

tools.name: GetDdl
tools.description: [read-only] Reads the CDS view (or classic DDL view) named by ddl_name in one request: its DDL source (part "source", the default; active or inactive version) or its ADT metadata document (part "metadata": package, responsible, description). Returns the part read. Recordable: in batch mode a call is recorded under the next number and answers with empty content; its answer is read by number after the batch ends.

part.description: The document to read: "source" (default) the source code, "metadata" the ADT metadata document (package, responsible, description, ...).

version.description: Version of the source: "active" (default) for the deployed version, "inactive" for the modified version awaiting activation.

tools.name: GetDomain
tools.description: [read-only] Reads the ABAP domain named by domain_name in one request: its ADT metadata document (definition, package, description). Returns it under `metadata`, with `part: "metadata"`. Recordable: in batch mode a call is recorded under the next number and answers with empty content; its answer is read by number after the batch ends.

version.description: Version to read: "active" (default) for deployed version, "inactive" for modified but not activated version.

tools.name: GetFunctionGroup
tools.description: [read-only] Reads the ABAP function group named by function_group_name in one request: its ADT metadata document (package, description, contents). Returns it under `metadata`, with `part: "metadata"`. Recordable: in batch mode a call is recorded under the next number and answers with empty content; its answer is read by number after the batch ends.

version.description: Version to read: "active" (default) for deployed version, "inactive" for modified but not activated version.

tools.name: GetFunctionInclude
tools.description: [read-only] Reads the include named by include_name of the ABAP function group named by function_group_name in one request: its source code (part "source", the default; active or inactive version) or its ADT metadata document (part "metadata"). Returns the part read. Recordable: in batch mode a call is recorded under the next number and answers with empty content; its answer is read by number after the batch ends.

part.description: The document to read: "source" (default) the source code, "metadata" the ADT metadata document (package, responsible, description, ...).

version.description: Version of the source: "active" (default) for the deployed version, "inactive" for the modified version awaiting activation.

tools.name: GetFunctionModule
tools.description: [read-only] Reads the ABAP function module named by function_module_name, BAPI or RFC-enabled ones included, in the function group named by function_group_name, in one request: its source code, which declares the parameter signature (part "source", the default; active or inactive version), or its ADT metadata document (part "metadata": package, responsible, description). Returns the part read. Recordable: in batch mode a call is recorded under the next number and answers with empty content; its answer is read by number after the batch ends.

function_group_name.description: Function group containing the function module.

part.description: The document to read: "source" (default) the source code, "metadata" the ADT metadata document (package, responsible, description, ...).

version.description: Version of the source: "active" (default) for the deployed version, "inactive" for the modified version awaiting activation.

tools.name: GetInterface
tools.description: [read-only] Reads the ABAP interface named by interface_name in one request: its source code (part "source", the default; active or inactive version) or its ADT metadata document (part "metadata": package, responsible, description). Returns the part read. Recordable: in batch mode a call is recorded under the next number and answers with empty content; its answer is read by number after the batch ends.

part.description: The document to read: "source" (default) the source code, "metadata" the ADT metadata document (package, responsible, description, ...).

version.description: Version of the source: "active" (default) for the deployed version, "inactive" for the modified version awaiting activation.

tools.name: GetMessageClass
tools.description: [read-only] Reads the ABAP message class (MSAG/T100) named by message_class_name in one request: its ADT metadata document (XML: name, description, package, master language, messages). Returns it under `metadata`, with `part: "metadata"`. Recordable: in batch mode a call is recorded under the next number and answers with empty content; its answer is read by number after the batch ends.

tools.name: GetMessageClassMessage
tools.description: [read-only] Reads the message numbered msgno of the ABAP message class (MSAG/T100) named by message_class_name in one request. Answers the one message under `message`: its number (msgno), text (msgtext), self-explanatory flag (selfexplainatory), long-text flag (documented), last changer (lastchangedby), change time (lastmodified), and every other field the system gives the message. A number absent from the class is refused as missing. Recordable: in batch mode a call is recorded under the next number and answers with empty content; its answer is read by number after the batch ends.

detail.description: How much of the answer to return: "terse" (default, the fields you need to act), "full" (the whole parse), "raw" (the document as ADT sent it).

tools.name: GetMetadataExtension
tools.description: [read-only] Reads the CDS metadata extension named by metadata_extension_name in one request: its source code (part "source", the default; active or inactive version) or its ADT metadata document (part "metadata": package, responsible, description). Returns the part read. Recordable: in batch mode a call is recorded under the next number and answers with empty content; its answer is read by number after the batch ends.

part.description: The document to read: "source" (default) the source code, "metadata" the ADT metadata document (package, responsible, description, ...).

version.description: Version of the source: "active" (default) for the deployed version, "inactive" for the modified version awaiting activation.

tools.name: GetPackage
tools.description: [read-only] Reads the ABAP package named by package_name in one request: its ADT metadata document (description, super-package, sub-packages, ...), active or inactive version. Returns it under `metadata`, with `part: "metadata"`: a summary, the details or the document as SAP sent it, per `detail`. Recordable: in batch mode a call is recorded under the next number and answers with empty content; its answer is read by number after the batch ends.

version.description: Version to read: "active" (default) for deployed version, "inactive" for modified but not activated version.

detail.description: How much of the answer to return: "terse" (default, the fields you need to act), "full" (the whole parse), "raw" (the document as ADT sent it).

tools.name: GetProgram
tools.description: [read-only] Reads the ABAP program (report) named by program_name in one request: its source code (part "source", the default; active or inactive version) or its ADT metadata document (part "metadata": package, responsible, description). Returns the part read. Recordable: in batch mode a call is recorded under the next number and answers with empty content; its answer is read by number after the batch ends.

part.description: The document to read: "source" (default) the source code, "metadata" the ADT metadata document (package, responsible, description, ...).

version.description: Version of the source: "active" (default) for the deployed version, "inactive" for the modified version awaiting activation.

tools.name: GetServiceBinding
tools.description: [read-only] Reads the OData service binding named by service_binding_name in one request: its binding document (part "source", the default) or its ADT metadata document (part "metadata": package, responsible, description), each in the response_format given. Returns the part read. Recordable: in batch mode a call is recorded under the next number and answers with empty content; its answer is read by number after the batch ends.

part.description: The document to read: "source" (default) the source code, "metadata" the ADT metadata document (package, responsible, description, ...).

response_format.description: Preferred response format. "json" requests JSON from endpoint, "xml" parses XML payload, "plain" returns raw text.

tools.name: GetServiceDefinition
tools.description: [read-only] Reads the service definition named by service_definition_name in one request: its source code (part "source", the default; active or inactive version) or its ADT metadata document (part "metadata": package, responsible, description). Returns the part read. Recordable: in batch mode a call is recorded under the next number and answers with empty content; its answer is read by number after the batch ends.

part.description: The document to read: "source" (default) the source code, "metadata" the ADT metadata document (package, responsible, description, ...).

version.description: Version of the source: "active" (default) for the deployed version, "inactive" for the modified version awaiting activation.

tools.name: GetStructure
tools.description: [read-only] Reads the ABAP structure named by structure_name in one request: its definition with its fields, as source code (part "source", the default; active or inactive version) or its ADT metadata document (part "metadata": package, responsible, description). Returns the part read. Recordable: in batch mode a call is recorded under the next number and answers with empty content; its answer is read by number after the batch ends.

part.description: The document to read: "source" (default) the source code, "metadata" the ADT metadata document (package, responsible, description, ...).

version.description: Version of the source: "active" (default) for the deployed version, "inactive" for the modified version awaiting activation.

tools.name: GetTable
tools.description: [read-only] Reads the ABAP database table named by table_name in one request: its definition with its fields, as source code (part "source", the default; active or inactive version) or its ADT metadata document (part "metadata": package, responsible, description). Returns the part read. Recordable: in batch mode a call is recorded under the next number and answers with empty content; its answer is read by number after the batch ends.

part.description: The document to read: "source" (default) the source code, "metadata" the ADT metadata document (package, responsible, description, ...).

version.description: Version of the source: "active" (default) for the deployed version, "inactive" for the modified version awaiting activation.

tools.name: GetUnitTestResult
tools.description: [read-only] Reads the result of the ABAP Unit test run named by run_id, for a run still running when its start answered. Waits for it within a bound. Runs outside batch mode.

run_id.description: Run id a unit test run answered.

detail.description: How much of the answer to return: "terse" (default, the fields you need to act), "full" (the whole parse), "raw" (the document as ADT sent it).

tools.name: GetServiceBindingPreviewUrl
tools.description: [read-only] Build the browser URL that previews a published service binding, and the service and $metadata URLs beside it. Answers: "open the service in a browser", "preview this service binding", "what is the OData URL of this binding". Reads the binding for the service, version and protocol, and the service definition for the entity sets; the preview URL needs an entity set, and the answer names what is missing. A Web API binding answers the service URLs alone. Runs outside batch mode.

entity_set.description: Entity set to open. Omitted, the first one the service definition exposes is used.

navigation.description: Association or composition to follow. Omitted, the first one of the exposed root view is used.

target_entity_set.description: Entity set the navigation reaches. Omitted, the second exposed entity set is used.

client.description: Client for the sap-client parameter. Omitted, the client the system reports is used; an empty string leaves the parameter out.

language.description: Logon language for the preview. Omitted, the language the system reports is used.

tools.name: GetTypeInfo
tools.description: [read-only] Retrieve ABAP type information for domains (DOMA), data elements (DTEL), table types, and structures. Returns field definitions, value ranges, fixed values, and DDIC metadata. Runs outside batch mode.

include_structure_fallback.description: When true (default), tries DDIC structure lookup only if type lookup returns 404/empty.

tools.name: GetTransaction
tools.description: [read-only] Reads the properties of the ABAP transaction (t-code) named by transaction_name in one request. Answers the transaction under `object` (name, text, type, package) and its facets under `properties`, in the order the system gives them — the application component chain, the package chain, type, owner, language, creation and the others the system names — each entry with its facet, name, displayName and text. Runs outside batch mode.

detail.description: How much of the answer to return: "terse" (default, the fields you need to act), "full" (the whole parse), "raw" (the document as ADT sent it).

tools.name: RuntimeCreateProfilerTraceParameters
tools.description: [read-only] [runtime] Schedule ABAP profiler trace parameters and return profilerId (the request id) for profiled execution. Recordable: in batch mode a call is recorded under the next number and answers with empty content; its answer is read by number after the batch ends.

tools.name: RuntimeListProfilerTraceFiles
tools.description: [read-only] [runtime] List ABAP profiler trace files available in ADT runtime. Returns structured entries with id, recordedAt, user, objectName, state, expiresAt, and sizing/timing fields. Recordable: in batch mode a call is recorded under the next number and answers with empty content; its answer is read by number after the batch ends.

tools.name: RuntimeGetProfilerTraceData
tools.description: [read-only] [runtime] Read profiler trace data by trace id/uri: hitlist, statements, or db accesses. Returns parsed JSON payload. Runs on an ABAP session of its own. Optional timeout (seconds): when it passes, the read is cancelled, its ABAP session logged off, and the system stays as it was. Set it below your MCP client's request limit — the TypeScript SDK's client cancels at 60 s; a client's cancel ends only the client's wait, and SAP runs the read on. Recordable: in batch mode a call is recorded under the next number and answers with empty content; its answer is read by number after the batch ends.

timeout.description: Seconds to wait for the answer: a whole number, at least 1, no default — without it the call waits until SAP answers. When it passes, the read is cancelled (its ABAP session is logged off) and the call answers that nothing was changed. Set it below your MCP client's request limit — the TypeScript SDK's client cancels at 60 s; a cancel does nothing to SAP.

trace_id_or_uri.description: Profiler trace ID or full ADT trace URI.

tools.name: RuntimeGetDumpById
tools.description: [read-only] [runtime] Read an ABAP runtime dump by its dump_id or URI. Answers a summary — runtime error, exception, terminated program, time, user, and the source position where it terminated — and the parsed dump. Recordable: in batch mode a call is recorded under the next number and answers with empty content; its answer is read by number after the batch ends.

dump_id.description: The dump's id, or its URI as a dumps feed entry carries it.

view.description: Dump view mode: default payload, summary section, or formatted long text.

enable_all_types.description: If true, expands the scope to all available object types (Eclipse 'select all' behavior) by flipping every isSelected flag in the scope XML. Default: false (SAP default scope). Note: on large systems this can make the search significantly slower.

enable_only_types.description: Restrict the search to ONLY these ADT object types (e.g. ['TABL/DS','TABL/DT'] for structures, ['DDLS/DF'] for CDS sources). SAP applies the selection server-side, so unwanted types (e.g. hundreds of CLAS/OC) are never searched nor returned — use this instead of enable_all_types to avoid huge result sets. Values must be object-type codes from THIS object's where-used scope (the searchable categories, e.g. 'CLAS/OC','INTF/OI','FUGR/FF','DDLS/DF', not result-row codes like 'FUGR/F'). tools.name: GetObjectInfo

Shows root, group nodes, and terminal leaves up to maxDepth. With enrich=true each node also carries its description and package, from a repository search. Takes parent_type and parent_name (one object: its tree) or objects (several objects: one tree per object, in the order given; a failed one as { OBJECT_TYPE, OBJECT_NAME, error }). Read in ADT batch envelopes: per tier the root node structures of its nodes, then their type nodes; with enrich, the search of every node last. Runs on an ABAP session of its own. Optional timeout (seconds): when it passes, the read is cancelled, its ABAP session logged off, and the system stays as it was. Set it below your MCP client's request limit — the TypeScript SDK's client cancels at 60 s; a client's cancel ends only the client's wait, and SAP runs the read on. Runs outside batch mode.

timeout.description: Seconds to wait for the answer: a whole number, at least 1, no default — without it the call waits until SAP answers. When it passes, the read is cancelled (its ABAP session is logged off) and the call answers that nothing was changed. Set it below your MCP client's request limit — the TypeScript SDK's client cancels at 60 s; a cancel does nothing to SAP.

objects.description: [read-only] Several objects, read together (give this or parent_type and parent_name)

maxDepth.description: [read-only] Maximum tree depth (default depends on type). Every object's own type folders and their contents are always shown (one tier); a higher value only descends further for PACKAGES, expanding nested subpackages that many tiers deep — no captured node-structure document shows a non-package object usefully recursable beyond its own type folders, so other object types are capped at one tier regardless of a higher value here.

enrich.description: [read-only] Whether to add description and package via SearchObject (default true)

include_descriptions.description: [read-only] Include each leaf's description. Where the system serves ADT batch, each description is read from the leaf's metadata: one more read per leaf, which on a large tree takes most of the call (default false)

tools.name: SearchSource
tools.description: [read-only] Search ABAP source text inside one or more packages (programs, function groups, classes). `packages` accepts `*` masks (Z*, /NS/Z*) alongside exact names; mask resolution is best-effort and scoped to the ADT repository-search result window — some matching packages may be left unscanned. For certainty, pass concrete package names. When using masks, narrow the mask itself and use `object_types`, `object_filter`, and `max_objects` as scan-target controls that apply after package resolution. Comments are searched by default; set exclude_comments=true to drop col-1 `*` and full-line `"` comments. The `version` parameter affects PROG and CLAS main include reads only — FUGR subinclude reads always go against the active version (the include endpoint reads the active version alone). `truncated.by_object_cap` means at least one object had MORE hits than `max_hits_per_object`, so that object's hits were capped. The object-count limit is `max_objects` (which sets `truncated.by_max_objects`). To avoid `by_object_cap`, raise `max_hits_per_object`. The scan is read in ADT batch envelopes: the searches of the package masks, each level of the package walk, then the sources of the scanned objects in envelopes of at most 300 reads (main sources and function group structures, then function group includes and function modules); `time_budget_ms` is checked before every envelope, and a scan it stops answers whole objects. Run only ONE SearchSource per destination at a time — multiple parallel SearchSource calls against the same SAP system saturate the scan backend and can make all of them time out. Prefer combining terms into a single call over parallel calls. A scan that stops before its last target answers `next_start_at`; pass it as `start_at` to go on. When `next_start_at` equals `start_at`, `time_budget_ms` passed before the first object was answered: raise `time_budget_ms` or lower `max_objects`. The answer carries `total_targets`, the scan targets of the walk; it is absent when `time_budget_ms` passed during the walk. Runs on an ABAP session of its own. Optional timeout (seconds): when it passes, the read is cancelled, its ABAP session logged off, and the system stays as it was. Set it below your MCP client's request limit — the TypeScript SDK's client cancels at 60 s; a client's cancel ends only the client's wait, and SAP runs the read on. Runs outside batch mode.

timeout.description: Seconds to wait for the answer: a whole number, at least 1, no default — without it the call waits until SAP answers. When it passes, the read is cancelled (its ABAP session is logged off) and the call answers that nothing was changed. Set it below your MCP client's request limit — the TypeScript SDK's client cancels at 60 s; a cancel does nothing to SAP.

query.description: Primary substring to match (case-insensitive, ABAP CS).

query2.description: Optional second substring. When set, both query and query2 must appear on the same line.

exclude.description: Up to 3 substrings; a line containing any of them is dropped.

packages.description: Packages to scan. Each entry is either an exact dev-class name or a `*` mask, where `*` stands for any characters and a namespace prefix may lead it.

object_filter.description: Glob applied to object names within each package (e.g. "Z*").

object_types.description: Subset of object families to scan (default: all three).

exclude_comments.description: Skip col-1 '*' and full-line '"' comment lines. Default false (comments are scanned).

max_hits_per_object.description: Cap hits per root object across its source units (default 100). When exceeded, truncated.by_object_cap=true is set. Raise this value if you need more hits per object.

emit_no_hits.description: When true, list zero-hit targets in a separate no_hits array. Default false.

max_objects.description: Cap the total objects scanned across all packages (default 500). Setting truncated.by_max_objects=true when exceeded.

start_at.description: Index of the first scan target to read, from `next_start_at` of the previous answer; 0 by default.

version.description: Source version for PROG and CLAS main include reads. Default active. FUGR subincludes always read the active version.

time_budget_ms.description: Internal scan deadline in ms. When exceeded, returns the hits of the objects before `next_start_at` with truncated.by_timeout=true and next_start_at; when next_start_at equals start_at, the deadline passed before the first object was answered: raise time_budget_ms or lower max_objects. Set this BELOW your client/transport timeout (e.g. 540000 for a 600s client) so you get a partial result instead of a hard cutoff.

Answers the state_handle: over Streamable HTTP send it as the state_handle argument of every call of the batch (or in the x-mcp-state-handle header).

tools.name: BatchEnd
tools.description: [read-only] Sends the recorded calls in one envelope with the credentials in force and ends batch mode. Splits SAP's answer into each call's parts and answers the number of recorded calls, of requests sent and of parts received; when sending fails, the parts received differ from the requests sent or the answer fails to split, answers that error, and every number of the batch then answers it.

tools.name: BatchAnswers
tools.description: [read-only] Answers the calls of the last executed batch by number: for each number asked, the tool's answer, built from the call's parts of SAP's response when the number is first read and kept for later reads; the numbers asked are processed in parallel. Takes one number or a list of numbers; an unknown number answers as unknown.

number.description: One batch number to read (an integer of at least 1); give this or numbers, not both.

numbers.description: Several batch numbers to read, answered in the order given; give this or number, not both.
